name: Screenshot in Sketch Browser
easing: frame EASE.inOut f0-16; bar f10-20; content fade f16-26; circle EASE.out f40-56; note wipe EASE.inOut f54-70
bestFor: Showing a real site/product/leaderboard screenshot with a pointer to the key area.
keyframeTable: screenshot visible (dark theme), orange circle mid-draw on the chosen region
circle done, view zooming into the region, note wiping
rest: zoomed on the region (1.8x), note below
script: Sketch browser (1100x620) draws with url bar.
Screenshot (assets/screenshots/<file>) fades in, inverted to the dark theme unless theme=original.
Orange pen circle draws on the chosen region (params.region fractions).
The view zooms 1.8x into that region; note wipes in below.

params.region: [x,y,w,h] fractions 0-1 of the screenshot to circle and zoom into (pick the part that matters)

callouts.text: orange circle on the key region

status: rendered (logo/screenshot slots show labelled placeholders until assets are fetched)
